extended:
**CENTRAL EXTENSIONS OF GERBES**

*AMNON YEKUTIELI*

36 pp, 10 sections.

**Abstract.** We introduce the notion of central extension of gerbes on a topo- logical space X. We show that there are obstruction classes to lifting objects and isomorphisms in a central extension. We also discuss pronilpotent gerbes. These results are used in the paper [Ye] to study twisted deformation quanti- zation on algebraic varieties.

**Outline.** Front matter; 0 Introduction; 1 Recalling some Facts on 2-Categories; 2 Prestacks on a Topological Space; 3 Extensions of Gerbes; 4 Obstruction Classes; 5 Sufficient Conditions for Existence of Obstr; 6 Pronilpotent Gerbes; 7 Fake Global Objects of Gerbes; References
